text: BAM share rose 0.24 percentage points over 26 hours, while the 7 day change is down 0.1 percentage points, leaving BAM at 34.1% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.3% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The top-node seat changed hands 65 times, best read as whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover.
